description: Deep burgundy long coat with narrow gold woven borders around front edges, cuffs and hem, worn over a cream high-neck long tunic with narrow gold trim. A matching burgundy cloth drape is fastened at one shoulder with a round gold brooch. A decorated brown-and-gold belt has a round buckle and a hanging ornamented end. Brown trousers and calf-high brown leather boots remain fully visible. No headgear, armor or weapon is visible; garments are opaque with long sleeves.
